name: Catholic Charities Mobile Pantry at Our Lady of the Lake
hoursNotes: Monthly drive-up distributions: 3rd Tuesday at 9am and 4th Saturday at 9am, while supplies last. Line up in the parking lot up to one hour before start.
requirements: Free and open to the community; basic registration info collected. A friend or family member may pick up on your behalf.
notes: Operated by Catholic Charities Dallas in partnership with the North Texas Food Bank; fresh fruits, vegetables, and other food at no cost.
